correctness.rationale: The Schein–Teclezghi classification specialized by t squared equal to identity gives all and only the singular identity-preserving maps. Root fibers enumerate conjugacy types as multisets of (a,b), yielding the exact weighted Euler product. The explicit singular composition has a parity collapse and an exceptional constant-identity left zero; it forces every nontrivial involution orbit and exactly the root-fibers of size one or two to be represented. An even nontrivial involution available for all \(n\ge5\) collapses every other retraction orbit, giving the matching construction. Standalone direct labeled enumeration, conjugacy counts, closure of explicit generators, and evaluation of actual map compositions confirm the structure through n=6, but all-degree correctness rests on the proof.
